verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents an optional plan-first flow for larger features, where the team picks options and mockups before anything is built and then hands the plan off as an implementation task. That is a pre-build alignment step, but the evidence never describes a formal approval gate an engineering lead must sign off before an agent can act. The documented approvals (Review Hub, GitHub required reviews, approval logging) all happen after the agent has already produced a diff/PR. Missing for 10: an explicit lead-approval gate on task scope/contract that blocks agent execution, a role-restricted spec sign-off, enforcement that agents cannot start without approval, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
